positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short 0.901% (3.75m shares) as of 2026-09-23, lag 4 sessions, up from 0.716% on 2026-09-16. The build falls exactly on the placement date (halt 21 Sep, placement announced 23 Sep at A$0.55). The likeliest reading is placees hedging their allocations: those shorts are covered by delivery of the new shares on the 29 Sep settlement, not by buying in the market. So it is neither squeeze fuel nor an informed bearish view. At under 1% of the register it is small either way. The priced lean of +0.70 comes mostly from the -10.6% 20-day and -9.0% 5-day run-up. The 5-day fall is placement pricing plus the gold slide.

outside_window.finding: Boundiali MRE update targeted early Q4 CY2026, with the drilling cut-off at end Sep 2026 and resource extensions flagged in the 18 Sep and 25 Sep drill releases. It will follow resource modelling after the cut-off, so it will not land by 1 Oct.

September-quarter Appendix 5B (the prior four landed 23-30 days after quarter end) will show cash after the A$52.5m placement settled 29 Sep. The company has already stated about A$95m pro-forma cash, so the quarterly is due by 31 Oct.

The 95.45m placement shares (about 23% of the pre-placement register) start trading 30 Sep, the session before the window. About A$20m of the book (roughly 37m shares, about 44 days of median turnover) went to non-strategic institutions, now about 8% underwater at A$0.505 against A$0.55. Any first-day selling lands on 30 Sep, which is outside the window. Own history of day-2 quotation moves is mixed: Dec 2024 -4.35%, Jun 2024 0.0%.

searched_and_found_nothing: Full 2024-2026 ASX announcement archive for AUE. No trading halt, voluntary suspension or unexplained price-sensitive release after 25 Sep 2026. No substantial-holder change since Perseus became a substantial holder (30 Mar 2026). No director selling (the latest 3Ys show buying: MD on 12 Jun 2026).
Annual-report content risk (impairment, going concern, audit qualification): not credible with about A$95m pro-forma cash and a PFS/Ore Reserve already delivered on 11 Jun 2026.

Own reaction to prior annual reports: 1 Oct 2024 -12.5% on a then-thinly-traded name, rebounding +9.5% the next session, and 2 Oct 2025 +1.4% (Yahoo shows a zero-volume 1 Oct 2025 bar). Half-year reports: -4.8% (Mar 2026) and +1.4% (Mar 2025). No consistent sign, and none of these documents carried new operating information.

The 28 Sep 2026 fall (-8.3% to A$0.495) matches spot gold -3.2% to about US$4,150 on the Hormuz/oil/rate-hike move (https://www.usagold.com/daily-precious-metals-market-report-september-28-2026/). That is a macro transmission, not company information.
Stockhead, mining.com.au, discoveryalert and Proactive coverage of the placement and the 18/25 Sep drill results: all wire-level and already priced.

The placement announcement and Appendix 3B are RC4-encrypted PDFs. I decrypted them locally and page 1 of the announcement is readable; the timetable (settle 29 Sep, trade 30 Sep) came from Proactive and discoveryalert, which agree with each other.
baseline_tension: No tension to resolve. I found nothing that agrees with or cuts against the +0.70 lean. The oversold 5-day and 20-day run-up is explained by the placement and by gold, and neither gives a reason to expect a reversal or a continuation on 1 Oct specifically.
